title: Import Lightroom brush groups and correct radial polarity and rotated geometry
source: rapidroom adaptation of measured XMP semantics from skymanbp/autoshade
notes: Aggregate Paint children retain stroke order, container visibility/inversion and subtract composition. Radial polarity uses MaskInverted alone; signed rotated pixel-space corners recover clockwise ellipse axes through orientation/crop rotation. Brush radius is in unoriented width units. Only imported mask geometry changes; non-imported edits and rendering algorithms remain unchanged. Brush flow/density and variable dab parameters, Lightroom falloff laws and local-strength calibration remain separate parity work. Opaque MaskBrushTable groups are skipped whole and explicitly reported; their bounded .acr decoder is follow-up #177. AI components remain unsupported and reported. Human visual acceptance of imported brush/radial coverage is required.
